고맙습니다.x: Thank you for showing me the way.
고맙습니다.e: From 고맙다 (to be grateful) — the native Korean partner of 감사합니다; both are polite.

이해하다.x: I understood the teacher's explanation well.
이해하다.e: Literally 'solve the reason' — figure out how something works.
이해하다.t: Didn't catch something? 잘 모르겠어요 is more natural than 이해 못 해요 in daily talk.

자주.forms: 자주 + verb: 자주 가요, 자주 만나요
자주.x: I often go to that café.

교환하다.ex: 이 신발을 큰 사이즈로 교환하고 싶어요.
교환하다.x: I'd like to exchange these shoes for a bigger size.
교환하다.t: Use N을/를 N(으)로 교환하다: "exchange A for B." In casual speech, 바꾸다 is more common.

검사.x: I had a blood test at the hospital yesterday.
검사.t: Homonym: 검사 also means 'prosecutor,' a different word with different hanja.

검사.ex: 검사가 법정에서 새로운 증거를 보여 줬어요.
검사.x: The prosecutor showed new evidence in court.
검사.e: Homonym warning: 검사 also means 'test, inspection', as in 건강 검사.
검사.t: Address a prosecutor as 검사님; 변호사 (lawyer) and 판사 (judge) end in -사 too.

햇볕.x: The sun was so hot that I wore a hat.
햇볕.e: 해 'sun' + 볕 'warm sunshine': the sun you feel on your skin.

길이.x: These pants are a little short.

마을.x: My grandmother lives in a small country village.
마을.t: 마을 is a village or small community; 동네 is your neighborhood, even in a big city.

입장료.ex: 이 박물관의 입장료는 어른 오천 원이에요.
입장료.x: Admission to this museum is 5,000 won for adults.
입장료.t: Pronounced [입짱뇨]: ㄹ turns into ㄴ after ㅇ.

이자.x: Bank interest rates are really low these days.
이자.e: Literally 'benefit's offspring' — money born from money.

물질.ex: 이 제품에는 몸에 해로운 물질이 들어 있어요.
물질.x: This product contains substances that are harmful to the body.
물질.t: Pronounced [물찔] — ㄹ before ㅈ in Sino words often becomes tense.

높임말.ex: 처음 만난 사람에게는 높임말을 써야 해요.
높임말.x: You should use polite speech with people you've just met.
높임말.t: Pronounced [노핌말]; 존댓말 means the same thing and is just as common.

차지하다.m: to take up, occupy; to account for; to win (a place)
차지하다.ex: 이 큰 침대가 방의 반을 차지해요.
차지하다.x: This big bed takes up half the room.

미역국.ex: 생일 아침에 엄마가 미역국을 끓여 주셨어요.
미역국.x: On my birthday morning, my mom made me seaweed soup.
미역국.t: Pronounced [미역꾹]: ㄱ becomes tense after ㄱ. Mothers eat it after giving birth, which is why it is eaten on birthdays. 미역국을 먹다 is also slang for failing an exam; it is usually explained by slippery seaweed suggesting 미끄러지다 'to slip', but that is a popular explanation, not a proven origin.

깡충깡충.e: Manner word (의태어) for short, light hops with both feet. Dark-vowel 껑충껑충 is for big, long leaps.
깡충깡충.t: The standard spelling is 깡충깡충, not the common misspelling 깡총깡총.

배출.x: Trash can be put out from 8 p.m.
배출.t: Two common uses: 탄소 배출 = carbon emissions, and 쓰레기 배출 = putting out the trash.

흐림.ex: 주말 날씨는 흐림이고 오후에 비가 올 수도 있어요.
흐림.x: The weekend weather will be cloudy, and it might rain in the afternoon.
흐림.e: Noun form of 흐리다 'to be cloudy', used as a forecast label.

안도.ex: 아이를 찾았다는 소식에 모두 안도의 한숨을 쉬었어요.
안도.x: At the news that the child was found, everyone sighed with relief.
안도.e: Literally 'at peace within one's walls' — safe at last.
안도.t: Set phrase: 안도의 한숨을 쉬다 'to breathe a sigh of relief'.

담담하다.x: She accepted the sad news calmly.
담담하다.e: Literally 'mild and mild' — like a light, plain flavor.

인내.x: Learning a foreign language takes patience.

견인.ex: 건물 앞에 불법 주차한 차가 견인됐어요.
견인.x: The car illegally parked in front of the building was towed.

발효.m: coming into force, taking effect (of a law or treaty)
발효.x: This agreement is scheduled to take effect next January.
발효.t: Homonym: 발효 (醱酵) means 'fermentation', as in kimchi; same sound, different hanja.

구호.ex: 지진 피해 지역에 구호 물자가 도착했습니다.
구호.x: Relief supplies arrived in the earthquake-hit area.
구호.t: At protests, 구호를 외치다 means 'chant slogans' — a different 구호.

비유.ex: 선생님은 어려운 개념을 쉬운 비유로 설명해 주셨어요.
비유.x: The teacher explained a difficult concept with an easy analogy.
비유.t: Pattern: A를 B에 비유하다 means to compare A to B.

둔화되다.m: to slow down, to become sluggish
둔화되다.x: Economic growth slowed considerably this year.

퇴보하다.m: to regress, to go backward, to decline
퇴보하다.ex: 변화를 거부하는 사회는 결국 퇴보하게 됩니다.
퇴보하다.x: A society that refuses change eventually regresses.

기인하다.m: to be caused by, to stem from
기인하다.ex: 이번 화재는 전기 문제에 기인한 것으로 보입니다.
기인하다.x: This fire appears to have been caused by an electrical problem.

변질되다.m: to go bad, to spoil; to be corrupted, to lose its original character
변질되다.ex: 여름에는 음식이 쉽게 변질되니까 냉장고에 보관하세요.
변질되다.x: Food spoils easily in summer, so keep it in the refrigerator.
변질되다.e: Literally 'change of quality' — usually for the worse.
변질되다.t: Figuratively: 본래 취지가 변질되다 'the original purpose gets distorted.'

회피하다.m: to evade, to dodge, to avoid (responsibility, a question)
회피하다.x: He evaded answering the reporters' questions.
회피하다.e: Literally 'turn around and avoid' — dodging rather than facing.
회피하다.t: 기피 = shunning something you dislike; 회피 = dodging something you should face, like 책임 or 질문.

의연하다.ex: 그녀는 어려운 상황에서도 의연한 태도를 잃지 않았어요.
의연하다.x: She never lost her composure, even in a difficult situation.
의연하다.e: Literally 'resolute-like' — staying firm and calm under pressure.

품위.ex: 그녀는 어떤 상황에서도 품위를 잃지 않아요.
품위.x: She never loses her dignity, no matter the situation.
품위.t: Common verbs: 품위를 지키다 'to keep one's dignity', 품위를 잃다 'to lose it'.

고집불통.m: stubborn person, mule-headed person; utter stubbornness
고집불통.ex: 우리 아버지는 고집불통이라서 남의 말을 잘 안 들으세요.
고집불통.x: My father is so stubborn that he rarely listens to other people.
고집불통.e: Literally 'holding on firmly and letting nothing through'.

다사다난하다.x: This has really been an eventful, difficult year.
다사다난하다.t: A year-end cliché: 다사다난했던 한 해를 보내며 'as we see off an eventful year.'

천진무구하다.ex: 아이의 천진무구한 웃음을 보면 기분이 좋아져요.
천진무구하다.x: Seeing a child's innocent smile puts me in a good mood.
천진무구하다.e: Literally 'naturally genuine, without a speck of dirt.'

내향적.ex: 저는 내향적인 성격이라서 혼자 있는 시간이 필요해요.
내향적.x: I have an introverted personality, so I need time alone.

연표.ex: 시험 전에 한국사 연표를 보면서 정리했어요.
연표.x: Before the exam, I reviewed using a timeline of Korean history.

위신.ex: 이번 스캔들로 정부의 위신이 크게 떨어졌습니다.
위신.x: This scandal greatly damaged the government's prestige.

어원.ex: 이 단어의 어원을 알면 뜻을 기억하기 쉬워요.
어원.x: If you know this word's origin, its meaning is easier to remember.

주권침해.m: violation of sovereignty, infringement of sovereignty
주권침해.ex: 정부는 이번 사건을 명백한 주권침해로 규정했습니다.
주권침해.x: The government defined the incident as a clear violation of sovereignty.

연역법.x: Mathematical proofs mainly use deductive reasoning.
연역법.t: Pronounced [여녁뻡]: the ㅂ tenses after ㄱ.

노심초사하다.ex: 어머니는 아들이 다칠까 봐 늘 노심초사하셨어요.
노심초사하다.x: Mom was always fretting that her son would get hurt.

화학식.x: Try writing the chemical formula for carbon dioxide on the board.
화학식.t: Pronounced [화학씩]; -식 = formula or style: 공식 (formula), 수식 (equation).

오픈소스.ex: 이 프로그램은 오픈소스라서 누구나 무료로 쓸 수 있어요.
오픈소스.x: This program is open source, so anyone can use it for free.

고취하다.m: to inspire, to instill, to boost (spirit or awareness)
고취하다.x: This campaign stirred up citizens' patriotism.
고취하다.e: Literally 'beat the drum and blow the horn' to rouse people.

해이하다.ex: 시험이 끝난 뒤 학생들의 분위기가 많이 해이해졌어요.
해이하다.x: After the exams ended, the students' attitude became quite lax.
해이하다.e: Literally 'untied and slackened' — like a loosened bowstring.
해이하다.t: Usually appears as 해이해지다 'to become lax', often with 기강 'discipline'.

고루하다.ex: 그런 고루한 생각은 이제 버려야 해요.
고루하다.x: You need to let go of that old-fashioned way of thinking.
고루하다.e: Literally 'rigid and crude' — stuck in old ways.
고루하다.t: It criticizes stubbornly outdated thinking, not age: 고루한 사고방식 'a fusty mindset'.

고단하다.ex: 하루 종일 일했더니 몸이 너무 고단해요.
고단하다.x: I worked all day, so I'm completely worn out.
고단하다.e: Covers both a tired body and a hard life: 고단한 삶 'a hard life'.

일절.m: not at all, never, absolutely not
일절.ex: 이 건물 안에서는 흡연을 일절 금지합니다.
일절.x: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside this building.
일절.e: Literally 'one cut': cutting something off completely.
일절.t: Same characters as 일체 'all'; use 일절 with negatives or bans, 일체 for 'everything'.

필터버블.ex: 추천 알고리즘은 필터버블을 만들 수 있습니다.
필터버블.x: Recommendation algorithms can create filter bubbles.

전도되다.m: to be inverted, to be turned upside down, to be reversed
전도되다.x: As money became the goal, values were turned upside down.
전도되다.e: Literally 'topple and fall over' — order or priorities flipped.
전도되다.t: 주객전도 'host and guest switched' describes the tail wagging the dog.

공교롭다.ex: 공교롭게도 우리는 같은 날 같은 옷을 입고 왔어요.
공교롭다.x: As luck would have it, we showed up in the same outfit on the same day.
공교롭다.e: Originally 'skillfully made'; now 'oddly well-timed', as if someone arranged it.
공교롭다.t: Usually as the adverb 공교롭게도 'as luck would have it', often for awkward coincidences.

휴머니즘.ex: 그 영화는 따뜻한 휴머니즘을 담고 있어요.
휴머니즘.x: That movie is full of warm humanity.
휴머니즘.e: From English 'humanism'; in Korean it often just means warm-hearted compassion.

혼돈.ex: 정권이 무너지자 나라 전체가 혼돈에 빠졌습니다.
혼돈.x: When the regime collapsed, the whole country fell into chaos.
혼돈.e: Literally 'mixed and murky', the formless state before order.

도원결의.ex: 세 친구는 도원결의를 하듯 함께 창업하기로 약속했어요.
도원결의.x: The three friends vowed, like sworn brothers, to start a business together.
도원결의.e: From Three Kingdoms: Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei swore brotherhood in a peach garden.

화중지병.m: pie in the sky, something you can't actually have
화중지병.ex: 돈이 없으면 그 계획은 화중지병일 뿐이에요.
화중지병.x: Without money, that plan is just pie in the sky.
화중지병.e: Literally 'a rice cake in a painting.'
화중지병.t: Everyday Korean says 그림의 떡 instead.
rel: a rice cake in a picture

사인.ex: 경찰은 아직 정확한 사인을 밝히지 못했습니다.
사인.x: The police have not yet determined the exact cause of death.
사인.t: Homonym warning: 사인 also means 'signature' (from English 'sign') and 'signal'; context tells you which.
